about_the_game:
In this turn-based combat adventure, defend humanity from demons. Choose your suitable warrior according to your opponent and the climate where you fight. Upgrade your weapons and armor. Cook your food, collect resources and work them to make your tools. Very colorful fights with spectacular landscapes. Select the appropriate attack, place your warrior in the perfect position to attack many enemies.

Hire warriors and improve your combat skills. Get resources to sell them and hire more warriors.

There are 6 classes of warriors, Samurai, Dwarves, Amazons, Sorcerers, Knights and Spartans.

You can have up to 11 warriors in your camp, but your battles are with a maximum of 4.

Some attacks can cause bleeding or stunning, which makes combat more dynamic and frenetic.

More than 5 types of enemies including werewolves, skeletons, orcs, yokai, goblins, dogs and demons.

You will travel through 6 islands with up to 5 different biomes which are created randomly, snow, forest, desert, rocks and ruins.

Each one with characteristics that affect or benefit your warriors.

The turns are per fighter and not per team.

When you win the battle you can choose between 3 prize options, choose the right one to stay strong.

Your attacks require energy and you can recover it by eating meat previously cooked in your camp.

From your camp you can create some materials that will help you improve the skills of your warriors.

You can cook, blacksmith, create arrows and spears, or smelt metals.
